ios.desc:
HogPocket brings your PostHog product analytics to your iPhone. Monitor your key metrics, explore events, and understand your users — all from a beautiful, native mobile experience.

DASHBOARD
- Daily, weekly, and monthly active users at a glance
- Real-time event volume and trends
- Retention rate tracking
- Interactive trend charts with annotations
- Weekly AI-powered digest summaries

EVENTS
- Top events ranked by volume with sparkline trends
- Detailed event drill-down with volume, change %, and daily averages
- Country breakdown per event with interactive 3D globe
- Time range filtering (7d, 14d, 30d, 90d)

USERS
- User growth and session trends
- Retention cohort analysis
- Users by country with flag indicators and bar charts
- Average session duration and events per session

FUNNELS
- Multi-step funnel visualization
- Conversion and drop-off rates
- Average conversion time per step

GLOBAL ANALYTICS
- Interactive 3D globe showing user distribution worldwide
- Country-level breakdown with event counts and percentages

MORE FEATURES
- Multi-account support — switch between PostHog projects
- Dark and light mode
- Pull-to-refresh across all screens
- Share dashboard screenshots
- Annotations to mark important events on your charts
- HogQL query editor for custom queries
- Session recordings, experiments, cohorts, paths, and goals

PRIVACY FIRST
HogPocket connects directly to your PostHog instance using your API key. Your data stays between you and your PostHog account — we never store or proxy your analytics data.

GETTING STARTED
1. Open HogPocket
2. Go to Settings
3. Enter your PostHog API key and host
4. Start exploring your data

Don't have a PostHog account yet? Try the app in Demo Mode with sample data to see what HogPocket can do.


TERMS & POLICIES

Privacy Policy: https://hogpocket.app/privacy
